You catch an ankle behind your shield’s lower edge, lift it and drive your opponent backward.

Rules

Action
Maneuver
Attribute
Brawn
Target / range / shape
One adjacent creature.
Duration
Instant.
Equipment / acquisition
Requires a held shield. Grants one ordinary shield, Bulk 1, if absent.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill / Control

NPC defense: Agility. This is an attack with no HP damage.

Weak
Push 1 square directly away from you.
Standard
Push 2 squares directly away from you.
Strong
Push 2 squares directly away from you and apply Prone.

Use the normal forced-movement and collision rules. Stability reduces the push, not Prone.
